scripts.text:
[Representative]
Welcome to ^8B4513Luoyang^000000,
an ancient land with
a history full of tales
of bravery.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
歡迎來到^8B4513龍之城^000000。
這片古老的土地，流傳著許多英雄傳說。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We now provide an ocean lane to accomodate foreign travelers and intercultural exchange from which all can benefit.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
如今我們開通了海上航線，方便外來旅客往來，促進文化交流，讓各方受益。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
^8B4513Luoyang^000000 is famous for
its elaborate history, as well as specialties that are unique to this nation. Please take your time and enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^8B4513龍之城^000000以悠久的歷史和獨有的物產聞名。
請慢慢遊覽，盡興而歸。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[代表]
點選^B9062F[地點名稱]^000000，便可獲得最先進的^B9062F導航^000000服務！

[Representative]
The <NAVI>[Dragon Castle]<INFO>louyang,218,253,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is located at ^0A82FF+^000000. It is where all the nobles reside, including our lord.
Since you're an outsider, I guess it would be appropriate for you to visit our lord first.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[代表]
<NAVI>[龍宮]<INFO>louyang,218,253,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>位於^0A82FF+^000000，是所有貴族居住的地方，我們的領主也住在那裡。你是外來者，我想先拜見領主比較合適。
